front: What did the Legal Age of Majority Act (1982) do?
back: Made all citizens, including women, legal adults at 18.
The 1981 policy that the economy should grow and its benefits be shared fairly with the majority.
The Economic Structural Adjustment Programme (from 1991): removal of controls and subsidies, devaluation, fees and cuts in state spending.
Price rises, school and clinic fees, retrenchments and unemployment, closure of some industries (worsened by the 1991-92 drought).

front: When was the Unity Accord signed and what did it do?
back: 22 December 1987: PF-ZAPU merged into ZANU-PF, ending the disturbances in Matabeleland and the Midlands.

front: When did the executive presidency begin?

back: The disturbances in Matabeleland and the Midlands (1983-1987), when the Fifth Brigade's actions killed many thousands of civilians (estimates up to about 20,000).

front: Give three social achievements of the 1980s.
back: Free primary education and rapid school expansion; rural clinics and immunisation; women's legal rights (1982).
